page.layout: One page of running text in one column; a note-free page with a running head at the top and a catchword-free foot. Below the last full line, a short word at the right ends the page.

main_text.p:
Non mutant habitus speciem. Nil ergo notabit
Hoc pulcrum Natura parens molita sepulcrum.
Non equidem prorsus ramis praesagia tollo:
Verum aliud credo signare. Suitica proles
Pannonias inuasit opes, iterumque reuerfi
Et fures, moechique, cucullatique Sophistae
In liquidas regni partes venere, quod aestu
Numinis irati fluidum patet vndique, quoque
Follibus arcanis Satanae quoque flamina mulcent.
His sese oblectant liquidis nunc sedibus illi,
Omnibus exemti curis, vacuique dolore,
Dulcibus optatum degunt in odoribus aeuum.
Sed prope tempus erit, cum regni mobilis humor
Frigore concrefcet cali, lacrymisque piorum
Durefcet, monachofque illic, turpefque Suitas
Flebilis includet miro fortuna sepulcro.
Vt quondam Albani ingressos sacraria templi
Obscoenos patres immissa incendia tollunt,
Vindice cum populus feuiret Marte per vrbem
Stupra dolens illata suis labemque nefandam
Coniugibus, monachofque furens, patrefque necaret.
Hoc fatum nostros manet exitiale Suitas,
Hoc Natura parens, hoc Naphtae lucidus humor
Significat, ranaeque monent, tremulaeque lacertae
Electro inclusae: testabitur exitus ingens.
Nanque ita nunc nostris haerent in finibus isti
Vt liquor Electri ranas admisit, eodem
Claufurus mox in tumulo remeare volentes.

page.notes: Lines are verse, set as one paragraph each stanza-block; the verse lines are printed as separate lines and were rendered here as line-broken text within one paragraph. The final word "Hoc" at the lower right is a line-initial fragment that continues onto the next page. Some words are uncertain due to the italic type and worn letters; no [?] markers were required for legible words. Long s was normalised to s; u/v and i/j were normalised per the rules.
